Description: Uses the original training recipe from ylacombe/finetune-hf-vits for the VCTK dataset.
Note: Layerdrop is meant to regularise the training, but seems to be causing issues in fine-tuning on LJSpeech.

Description: Training has been updated to remove the layerdrop component from the text encoder.
Note: This is essentially the “base case” of our analysis.

Description: Alternate speaker embedding with the highest cosine similarity to the LJSpeech target speaker.
Note: Male speaker. Although cosine similarity is higher, both pitch and Mel reconstruction loss are far worse.

Description: Train the speaker-embedding, with the rest of the model frozen. This makes training far more efficent, at the cost of limited refinement.

short_description: Fine-tune speaker embedding only. 10X learning rate.
Description: Train the speaker-embedding only, but with a more reasonable learning rate compared to experiment 4a.
Note: Experiment 4a isn’t really needed, except to show that we’re not changing more than 1 variable at the same time (model freezing AND learning rate)
